rule: A test file may be listed here only with a measured wall time above thresholdMs, recorded with its date and instrument. The list excludes files from the aggregate sweep in check-content-integrity.mjs; the excluded files run in .github/workflows/content-integrity.yml instead. The list is not a place to park a failing test.

gateStatus.promotionCondition: First clean pass of the swept set on the operator's machine; record the date and the measured wall time here when it changes.

instrument: node --test <file>, one file per process, wall time measured around the process; 2026-09-06 figures are from a four-core Linux sandbox without the shared Python venv and are upper bounds for the operator's machine.

entries.note: hit a 100 s cap; true duration unmeasured
